title: Welcoming the Nepalese Government to Have I Been Pwned
summary: Troy Hunt announces that the Nepalese Government has joined Have I Been Pwned (HIBP), a breach notification service that alerts organizations when their domains appear in data breaches. This enables government IT departments to proactively notify employees and reset compromised credentials.
problem_solved: Helps government agencies detect when employee credentials have been exposed in data breaches before attackers can exploit them.
why_valuable: Government agencies often have sensitive data and high-value targets, making proactive breach notification critical for national security and citizen data protection.
